description: This file contains selectors and utility functions for managing access control policies and related channel data in a Mattermost Redux state management setup.

methods.name: getAccessControlSettings
methods.description: Selector to retrieve access control settings, prioritizing admin config over client config.

methods.name: getAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Function to get a specific access control policy by ID from the state.

methods.name: getChannelIdsForAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Selector to get channel IDs associated with a specific access control policy.

methods.name: makeGetChannelsInAccessControlPolicy
methods.description: Factory function that creates a selector to retrieve channels associated with a specific access control policy, including team data.

methods.name: searchChannelsInheritsPolicy
methods.description: Function to search channels within a specific access control policy matching a search term and filters.
